Unisale POS

Unisale POS is a business management and point-of-sale platform designed to help businesses manage everyday operations from one system.

  • Sales terminal with receipts and refunds
  • Stock levels, adjustments and purchase orders
  • Suppliers, categories and brands
  • Cash-outs and expenses from the till
  • Sales dashboard and PDF reports
  • Multiple branches with stock transfers
